summary: BTQ Technologies filed a Form 6-K attaching a September 30, 2026 news release announcing a three-year commercial agreement with Kaia DLT Foundation to deploy its Quantum Secure Stablecoin Network across the Kaia blockchain, with LINE NEXT's Unifi Wallet positioned as an early consumer application. BTQ receives a share of transaction fees from QSSN-secured activity, expecting six-figure first-year USD revenue tied to transaction volume. No securities transaction, shareholder vote, or board recommendation is involved; the filing is an ordinary commercial-contract disclosure, not a special situation.
